metadata.description: Agent skills for mind reading, high agency, adversarial quality loops, multi-agent orchestration and evidence-driven optimization

plugins.name: jerry-skills
plugins.description: Five skills: mind-reading (expand a terse prompt into the full brief you meant, from a model of your own transcripts), high-agency (own tasks to a verified result), iterative-improvement (criteria-driven adversarial improvement loop), agent-sessions (orchestrate Claude, Codex and Gemini child sessions with verify gates, budgets and best-of-N) and competitive-systems (evidence-driven performance work with a portable dev.py).
